name: Istanbul, Turkey 🇹🇷
subtitle: Bosphorus dining — from meyhanes to modern Anatolian
items: Mikla (Mehmet Gürs, Pera Hilton rooftop — modern Anatolian fine dining, views over the Golden Horn)
Çiya Sofrası (Kadıköy, Musa Dağdeviren — regional Turkish cooking as anthropology, incredible)
Neolokal (Stone Store, Maksut Aşkar, 1-star — modern meyhane, extraordinary mezze + mains)
Karaköy Lokantası (Karaköy, chic version of classic lokanta)
Zübeyir Ocakbaşı (Beyoğlu, Tünel — mangal grill, adana kebab, meze, the real deal)
Asitane (Edirnekapı, Ottoman Imperial cuisine — researched from palace records)
Nar Restaurant (Kuruçeşme, sophisticated Turkish)
360 Istanbul (Beyoğlu, rooftop bar + restaurant — the panoramic view)
Balıkçı Sabahattin (Sultanahmet, since 1927 — the fish restaurant in the old city, seasonal)
Pandeli (Grand Bazaar, since 1901 — upstairs, classic Ottoman-Turkish, historic)
Hamdi Restaurant (Eminönü, since 1963 — views of Golden Horn, best lahmacun in the old city)
Hafız Mustafa 1864 (multiple, baklava + Turkish delight + desserts — the original)
Kapalıçarşı (Grand Bazaar) breakfast stalls
Nusr-Et Steakhouse (Beşiktaş, Salt Bae — the original, for the cultural experience)
Aheste (Asmalımescit, mezze + mains + natural wine, Beyoğlu)
Levent area wine bars (Ulus, rooftop terraces, wine + meze)
Çukurcuma antique + café district (Beyoğlu, artisanal coffee)
Boğaz köprüsü fish boats (Galata Bridge, grilled fish sandwich from the rocking boats — a must)
Karadeniz Pide ve Döner (Üsküdar, the best pide in Istanbul)
Balık Ekmek (Eminönü fish sandwich boats — the original fast food of Istanbul)
